## Hypothesis

Adding SNIPER-style profit-lock thresholds (5% arm, 10% floor) and tightening early-morning no-trade window to 09:35 improves consistency on non-J days while preserving J-winner capture, aiming to increase edge_capture via reduced loser-day losses.

## Mechanism

Enter on V14E bearish setup when confidence>=high and score>=9 after 09:35 ET. Exit rules: TP1 at 30% of entry premium (sell 50% of position), profit-lock arms at +5% favor raising the stop to entry×(1+0.05), trailing to +10% floor (entry×1.10) thereafter; runner target at 250% of entry premium. Strike offset 0 (ATM), min_triggers_bear=1, premium stop -20% catastrophe cap.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ≈14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Sweep evaluated over 16-month OPRA window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with 5 keepers selected from top 0.2% of 26K combos; high overfit risk due to selection bias.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top-3 J days not validated against realistic OPRA slippage).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day likely a large gap against direction triggering premature profit-lock stop; max drawdown could exceed -$1.5K on a single day; blow-up scenario if profit-lock triggers during strong trend, capping runner and turning winners into losers.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days contributed ~14.8% of wide_pnl (per keeper JSON top5_pct field truncated); indicates moderate concentration but still reliant on few large days.
